description: RTV-40 labelled clause->control eval set. Each case is a contract clause and the DORA controls it AFFECTS (expectedControls, by control-library id). The eval harness (scripts/evaluateClauseMapping.js) + the CI gate (tests/unittest/clauseMapping.test.js) measure the deterministic PATTERN mapper's precision/recall against these labels, so mapping quality can't silently regress when the library patterns change. Model-free by design; the LLM-assist path is exercised separately by unit tests.

cases.clause: The Provider shall meet the service level targets set out in Schedule B, including quantitative and qualitative performance targets measured monthly.
The Financial Entity shall have the right to audit the Provider, including unrestricted rights of access and on-site inspection of the Provider's premises.
The Provider shall permit pooled audits organised jointly by several financial entities relying on the same service.
The Financial Entity maintains an exit strategy and a documented exit plan enabling transition to an alternative provider without disruption.
The Provider shall maintain ICT security measures aligned with recognised security standards, and holds ISO 27001 certification and a SOC 2 Type II report.
The Provider shall maintain a business continuity plan and disaster recovery arrangements, subject to annual resilience testing.
Subcontracting of the services requires prior notification of changes to any subprocessors, and the Financial Entity retains a right to object.
The Provider shall provide assistance in the case of an ICT incident and ensure prompt notification of incidents affecting the services.
The Provider shall maintain an incident response capability available to the Financial Entity at no additional cost.
This clause specifies the regions or countries where data is to be processed and the storage location of all backups.
All processing shall take place only at the storage location approved in writing by the Financial Entity.
The Provider shall ensure the availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of personal data processed under this agreement.
The Financial Entity has the right to terminate the agreement for material breach subject to a thirty-day notice period.
Either party may exercise its termination rights in the circumstances described in clause 12.
Upon termination, the Provider shall provide exit assistance during a transition period, including the return and deletion of data and support for data portability.
The management body has adopted a third-party risk strategy and a policy on the use of ICT services supporting the firm's key activities.
The Financial Entity maintains a register of information covering all contractual arrangements supporting each critical or important function.
Prior to entering the arrangement the Financial Entity performs due diligence and a risk assessment prior to contracting, and checks for any conflict of interest.
The Financial Entity conducts ongoing monitoring of the Provider, including a periodic service performance review measuring performance against agreed metrics.
Schedule A sets out a full description of the services and the scope of services, listing the functions to be provided by the Provider.
The Provider agrees to cooperate with the competent authorities and any resolution authorities, ensuring full regulatory cooperation.
This schedule forms the full service level agreement, sets precise quantitative service targets, and provides for updates and revisions on an annual basis.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of France and any dispute shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Paris.
The total fees payable under this Agreement are set out in Schedule C and shall be invoiced monthly in arrears within thirty days.
